notes:
{外国人|がいこくじん} is the standard, neutral term for a person from another country.

WORD COMPARISON:
- {外国人|がいこくじん}: foreigner (neutral, polite)
- ⟦{外人|がいじん}→外人：25700_gaijin⟧: foreigner (casual, can sound rude or exclusive)
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: person from overseas (very polite)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {外国人|がいこくじん}⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧: foreign tourist
- {外国人|がいこくじん}⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧: foreign worker
- ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{外国人|がいこくじん}: foreign resident
- {外国人|がいこくじん}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: foreigner registration

USAGE:
Use {外国人|がいこくじん} in formal or polite situations. ⟦{外人|がいじん}→外人：25700_gaijin⟧ is common in casual speech but some find it exclusionary.
